content.text:
Finding submitted — **compliant**, no redline proposed.

**Summary:** Section 12 warrants the Software will conform to Specifications in all material respects for the acceptance period plus one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and continuing while Maintenance Services remain in place. That equals or beats the preferred 12-month software warranty. Meaningful remedies exist across the agreement: no-charge repair (§10(c)), rejection with full refund of all amounts paid (§7/§8), and recovery of direct damages preserved under §15. There is no "AS IS" clause and no implied-warranty disclaimer anywhere in the document, so the express warranty is not undercut.

Gaps noted in the rationale only (not deviations): no professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, no no-malicious-code warranty, and no compliance-with-laws warranty. These are worth adding if the agreement is reopened, but they do not drop the clause below the fallback.
